# TensorFlow.js 4.22.0

Official @tensorflow/tfjs and @tensorflow/tfjs-backend-wasm distributions,
version 4.22.0. Downloaded 2026-09-17 from the public npm distributions via:
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tensorflow/tfjs@4.22.0/dist/
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tensorflow/tfjs-backend-wasm@4.22.0/dist/

Source: https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs/tree/v4.22.0
Apache License 2.0; see LICENSE.

Included: tf.min.js, tf-backend-wasm.min.js, scalar and SIMD WASM binaries.
Multithreading is disabled. No separate GPU context or cross-origin isolation
is required, and no CDN/network requests occur at runtime.
